gateScope: Framework/docs/Design Studio/Synth builds, documentation examples, zero-dependency contract, full test suite with coverage, documentation audit, packaged-release conformance, and repository/package/history security audit.
skips: Real XFS hard-limit test requires a disposable XFS mount in CLANK_XFS_TEST_MOUNT.
Two real Docker integration tests require CLANK_DOCKER_INTEGRATION=1 on a disposable VM.
incrementalValidation: Node 22/24 full gates preceded comment-only DOM condensation and the durable test correction. Canonical compiled runtime and benchmark harness hashes match the measured candidate. The final durable test passed all 8 cases on Node 22/24/26 and was included in the final complete Node 26 gate; Node 22/24 were also rerun against the final canonical build.

resolvedFailures.cause: Node 26 native output preserved comments and exceeded the 12,000-byte DOM gzip budget at 12,193 bytes.
resolvedFailures.resolution: Condensed six comments; final Node 26 gzip is 11,929 bytes. Node 22/24 compiled output is byte-identical. No budget increase.

resolvedFailures.cause: Existing bulk-edit rollback test assumed insertion order when records share a millisecond creation time.
resolvedFailures.resolution: Compare record IDs and scores, and force tied timestamps with descending IDs. The original positional assertion fails deterministically against baseline; no runtime ordering change.

negativeControls: Original DOM implementation fails the rotation regression at 999 insertions instead of 1.
Original backend invalidation fails its bounded work regression at 16,513 record-metadata reads against a 256-read ceiling.
Original platform code fails zero per-project authorization and two aggregate-query regressions (10 and 78 queries respectively).
independentReviews: Platform query changes reviewed by rendering agent; no actionable findings.
Backend invalidation changes reviewed by platform agent; no actionable findings.
Bulk-edit test ordering independently confirmed by backend agent.
Report math independently checked against raw results; desktop viewport corrected to 1280x633.
benchmarkIntegrity: All candidate source hashes, canonical Node 22 distribution hashes, and benchmark harness hashes match manifest.json after final build. Raw results include all measured slower trials and failed latency acceptance rounds.
securityScope: No dependencies, production data, production load, password-strength/default concurrency changes, sandbox changes, or increased performance budgets.
